policy.purpose: Conservative quarantine for label review; thresholds are data-quality screening limits, not clinical intake limits.
policy.sourceUnits: Only numeric OFF *_100g values are used: nutrient mass in g per 100 g/100 ml. No percentages or daily values are inferred.
policy.saltSodiumConsistency: salt = sodium * 2.5; absolute tolerance 0.1 g or relative tolerance 10%, whichever is greater.
policy.massBalance: For base g only, protein + carbohydrates + fat + sodium + calcium + iron + potassium <= 105 g (5 g rounding margin). Never applied to ml.
policy.cholesterolFatConsistency: Cholesterol mass cannot exceed total fat mass by more than 20 mg (rounding margin).
policy.action: Exclude the whole record; never rescale, replace or silently omit a suspect nutrient.
